description:
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer, basé-e au choix à Paris.

 

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons DaiLY, notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH. 

 

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "Builder" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

 

 🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&A) à un véritable système agentique transactionnel capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).

 

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

  1. Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités
  • Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).
  • Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.
  1. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)
  • Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).
  • Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.
  • Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).
  • Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.
  • Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

Your role
The primary purpose of our AI Transformation Architect team is to accelerate the adoption and realization of value from our AI platform by embedding within our most strategic customer accounts. AI Transformation Architects will act as the company's most technically fluent business consultant and the customer's most trusted AI architects throughout the presales motion. 

What you'll do

  • Business Translation and Discovery: Rapidly embed with customer stakeholders and operational leaders to deeply understand their most complex, high-stakes business problems. Translate ambiguous business objectives into clear, Agentic AI solutions.
  • The Go-To-Market Bridge: Partner directly with our Sales, Sales Engineers, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to serve as the deep technical authority during critical pre-sales evaluations. You don't just sell the vision; you create technical validation through strategic AI workshops and Proofs of Concept.
  • Product Alignment and Influence: Capture common customer pain points, successful integration patterns, and platform limitations discovered in the field. Synthesize and deliver this critical, high-value signal directly back to our core Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap and accelerate feature development.
  • AI Envisioning: Navigate complex enterprise infrastructure (cloud, on-prem, data pipelines) to scope integration feasibility. Guide customers through their Agentic AI evaluation, advising and prototyping integration and custom data connectors, orchestration logic, and full-stack systems that bring AI to life.
  • Agentic AI Discovery: Discover and advise complex multi-agent systems, architectures, and fine-tuned models tailored to the customer's unique data, domain, and security requirements during the presales motion.  As part of AI envisioning workshops, demonstrate feasibility of multi‑step prompts, retrieval pipelines, and decision logic that plug into CRMs, ERPs, and custom APIs via our MCP framework.

Skills you'll bring

  • 4+ years of experience in a high-impact, customer-facing technical role such as AI Architect, Technical Consulting, high touch Sales Engineering or Solutions Architecture, or technical consulting for SaaS/AI products.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise in the modern AI/ML stack: LLMs, Generative AI concepts, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks. Proficiency in Python, Go, JS/TS plus hands‑on experience with LLM frameworks.
  • Unrivaled Business Acumen: The ability to simplify technical complexity and communicate clear trade-offs, value propositions, and project plans to both a core engineering team and a non-technical C-suite executive.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, take full ownership of outcomes, and are driven by delivering tangible, measurable results for the customer, often working under tight timelines.
  • Contributor to a dynamic team culture, focused on high growth industry innovation, team collaboration, customer success, and having fun!

Why Join Dialpad

  • Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
  • Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
  • Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

description:
Notre équipe Digital Sports recherche un·e Software Engineer Android basé·e à Lille.

Notre sens : "Bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all."
Chez Decathlon, notre ambition est claire : rassembler autour du sport et rendre le bien-être accessible au plus grand nombre.
Pour donner vie à cet objectif, nous nous appuyons sur deux forces majeures :

  • Nos coéquipiers, qui sont le cœur battant de notre écosystème.
  • Notre ancrage local, qui nous lie à chaque communauté sportive pour offrir des solutions uniques (produits, services et expériences).

Pour propulser cette vision, le Digital est un levier clé.

Ton futur terrain de jeu : la Digital Sport Unit
Véritable trait d'union entre nos marques sportives et le digital, cette équipe conçoit les solutions de demain.
En nous rejoignant, tu auras un impact direct : tu contribueras à créer et déployer des produits, services et expériences digitales pour simplifier le quotidien de nos coéquipiers et enchanter la pratique de nos utilisateurs sportifs.

Le Connected Locker, c'est le cœur logiciel qui fait le pont entre tous nos produits physiques (vélos, tapis, montres) et l'écosystème digital de Decathlon.

Ton défi ? Absorber la complexité. Chaque produit a ses propres protocoles et spécificités hardware ; le rôle du CL est d'unifier tout cela dans une librairie modulaire et robuste pour que les développeurs d'applications (Decathlon HUB, Mobility..) puissent intégrer n'importe quel équipement en quelques lignes de code.

 

TES MISSIONS

  • Architecture Modulaire & Design de SDK : Concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture Kotlin découplée et évolutive, permettant d'ajouter de nouveaux types de produits sans réécrire le cœur du système..

  • onnectivité Hybride & IoT : Maîtriser le stack Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) sous Android (gestion des cycles de vie, scans, reconnexions, spécificités constructeurs/ROMs) pour le local, et le MQTT/REST pour la communication Cloud

  • Développement d'une "Test App" : 

    • Développer et maintenir une application de test dédiée (Jetpack Compose).

    • Permettre aux QA de valider les fonctionnalités du SDK en isolation.

    • Intégrer des outils de simulation (mocking) pour tester les cas d'erreurs hardware difficiles à reproduire en réel 

  • Abstraction (L'Art du SDK Android) : Créer des API publiques simples et idiomatiques (Kotlin Coroutines / Flow) pour masquer la complexité des machines d'états hardware aux applications utilisatrices.

 

STACK TECHNIQUE

    • Langage : Kotlin (100%)

    • Asynchronisme : Coroutines, StateFlow / SharedFlow

    • Connectivité / IoT : Android BLE Stack, MQTT (ex: Paho/HiveMQ), AWS IoT Core, REST / WebSockets

    • UI (Test App) : Jetpack Compose

    • Architecture & Injection : Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Hilt / Koin)

    • Outillage / CI-CD : Gradle (Build Logic / Version Catalogs), Git, CI/CD pipelines pour publication de SDK/AAR.

CE DONT TU AS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Tu es un·e expert·e Kotlin / Android avec une vraie vision "Plateforme / SDK" (tu penses bibliothèque/AAR recontextualisable avant de penser écran/UI).
  • Tu maîtrises le BLE sous Android et connais ses pièges (permissions, restrictions arrière-plan, variations selon les versions d'OS/constructeurs), et tu es à l'aise avec les protocoles réseau temps réel (MQTT).
  • Tu as une solide expérience en architecture logicielle (Design Patterns, Modularité, Injection de dépendances).
  • Tu es basé à Lille, prêt à tester ton code sur les machines de sport à 50m de ton bureau.
  • Une appétence forte pour le travail en équipe et une culture du partage.
  • Un intérêt pour l’impact du sport sur le développement personnel et collectif
  • L’envie de rejoindre une entreprise engagée dans le Tech4Good et l’innovation responsable.

 

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it. Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so. Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you. Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR. What we're looking for Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong. Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

Role Overview

Fireblocks Liechtenstein Ltd. is a payment institution being established to provide Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) to institutional clients across the European Economic Area, under authorisation from the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority (FMA). 

The Director of Operations is a controlling-function role and a member of the Company’s executive management. The role holds primary day-to-day accountability for the sound operation of the licensed entity, acts as the principal local point of contact with the FMA, and provides the substance and operational governance that underpin the Company’s authorisation. 

The role has a defined and focused scope: the Company provides AIS and PIS services, with its technology platform operated by an intra-group technology provider. The Director of Operations is responsible for governing that arrangement and ensuring the entity operates soundly, rather than for building or running technology directly. The role may also support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory and Governance

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact with the FMA for operational matters, managing the ongoing supervisory relationship.
  • Ensure the Company operates at all times within the scope and conditions of its authorisation.
  • Own the Company’s regulatory reporting obligations and coordinate the annual statutory and regulatory audit.
  • Support the Board and executive management in discharging their governance responsibilities, including preparation and follow-through on Board matters.

Operational Oversight

  • Hold day-to-day accountability for the operational delivery of the Company’s AIS and PIS services.
  • Oversee the outsourcing arrangement with the technology provider, including monitoring of service levels, quarterly service reviews, and management of the outsourcing register and sub-outsourcing controls.
  • Own the Company’s business continuity and incident management framework, acting as the escalation and decision point in the event of a material disruption.
  • Oversee the segregated operational processes that support the Company’s regulatory perimeter, including customer onboarding, support routing, and data governance in coordination with the Risk & Compliance function.

Risk and Control

  • Work closely with the Risk & Compliance function to ensure an effective control environment across AML/CFT, operational, ICT, and outsourcing risk.
  • Ensure the Company meets its obligations under applicable Liechtenstein and EEA regulation, including PSD2/ZDG and, as applicable, DORA.
  • Oversee the maintenance of the Company’s risk register and the periodic and permanent control framework.

Commercial and Financial Governance

  • Oversee the commercial and financial governance of the entity, including the intra-group service arrangements, in coordination with group finance.
  • Provide operational sign-off on customer onboarding to the entity, ensuring the dual-entity contracting process is completed and customers are correctly provisioned.
  • Support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant, bringing operational and regulatory experience to bear. 

Candidate Profile

  • Proven operational leadership experience within a regulated financial institution — a payment institution, e-money institution, bank, or crypto-asset service provider.
  • Experience of the Liechtenstein or wider EEA regulatory environment, ideally including prior involvement in a licence application and ongoing regulator engagement.
  • A payments background, with an understanding of open banking (AIS/PIS), payment operations, and the associated regulatory obligations.
  • Familiarity with outsourcing governance and the operation of a licensed entity that relies on an intra-group or third-party technology provider.
  • Exposure to the digital asset sector is an advantage.

Attributes

  • The standing and seniority to act credibly as a controlling function before the FMA.
  • Sound judgement, personal accountability, and the ability to operate as the responsible individual for a licensed entity.
  • Able to work effectively with a distributed group, including colleagues in other time zones.
  • Fit and proper for a controlling-function role, satisfying the FMA’s suitability assessment.

Location and Presence

The role does not require full-time residence in Liechtenstein. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs. The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment. In this role, you’ll get to: Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate. Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision. Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away. Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone. You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.

The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country-based execution to a coordinated EMEA-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.

In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day-to-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision-making.

Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.

  • Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution. 
  • Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.

Responsibilities:

You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.

You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)

You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.

description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.
  • Project Delivery: Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Feasibility & Economics: Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Team Leadership: Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.
  • Work Experience: Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.
  • Technical Depth: You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

 

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

Le recrutement vise à renforcer l'offre de formation d'IMT Nord Europe dans le domaine du BIM et à développer une activité de recherche originale à l'interface entre la maquette numérique, la connaissance des matériaux, l'éco-conception, l'économie circulaire et la performance globale des bâtiments sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie. • Traiter les questions d'interopérabilité, de qualité et de gouvernance des données : formats IFC, openBIM, bases de données matériaux, ontologies, modèles de données, tableaux de bord d'indicateurs et aide à la décision ; description: INTITULÉ : « Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ». SPÉCIALITÉS : « Qualité de l'air intérieur, Physico-chimie de l'air, Performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments ». ÉTABLISSEMENT D'AFFECTATION : École Nationale Supérieure Mines-Télécom Lille Douai dont le nom d'usage est IMT Nord Europe. Direction / Service : Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) Responsable hiérarchique : Directrice du CERI Énergie Environnement Catégorie : Agent de catégorie A ou contractuel cadre de gestion de catégorie II Nature du poste : CDI Lieu de travail : Site de Douai. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de l'École sont à prévoir CONTEXTE École sous tutelle du ministère de l'économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l'Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l'innovation et les créations d'entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital. Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants : • Énergie Environnement • Systèmes Numériques • Matériaux et Procédés L'École dispose également d'antennes à Dunkerque, Valenciennes et Alençon. Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l'Ecole : www.imt-nord-europe.fr Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/). Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l'efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. Le CERI est structuré en trois axes thématiques : EFT (Énergie, Fluides et Transferts), OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques) et QEI (Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs). L'axe thématique QEI porte sur l'étude, l'identification et la caractérisation des sources de polluants dans les espaces clos et/ou confinés, l'analyse des interactions entre l'air intérieur et les matériaux, ainsi que l'étude de l'influence des environnements sur l'exposition et le bien-être des occupants. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition. Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. Ces environnements doivent concilier les transitions environnementales et énergétiques avec la qualité de l'air et le confort des occupants. L'ambition est de consolider le positionnement d'IMT Nord Europe dans ce domaine, avec une synergie entre recherche et formation. Il s'agit de renforcer un réseau de recherche et d'enseignement interdisciplinaire sur cette thématique en réponse à des attentes sociétales, des pouvoirs publics et des acteurs socio-économiques. Le recrutement s'effectue sur un projet de recherche et d'enseignement porté par un ou une titulaire de doctorat et s'inscrivant dans cette stratégie. Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après. MISSIONS : Sous l'autorité de la directrice du CERI EE, le ou la titulaire du poste participera aux activités d'enseignement, de recherche et de transfert de technologie : Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie : Dans le cadre général de la stratégie scientifique précédemment décrite, les recherches auront pour objectif de développer des connaissances scientifiques et des outils avec pour finalité l'amélioration de la qualité de l'air des environnements intérieurs (en particulier mais de manière non exclusive dans les bâtiments), de la santé, du confort et de l'exposition des occupants tout en accompagnant les transformations du cadre bâti nécessaires à la transition écologique et énergétique. Les thèmes de recherche attendus pourraient porter sur : • La préservation de la QEI face au changement climatique et à la nécessaire adaptation à ce changement ; • Les contributions des environnements intérieurs à l'exposition des occupants en intégrant les moyens d'évaluation et d'optimisation de l'exposition et du confort des occupants ; • Les impacts de la sobriété énergétique des systèmes énergétiques innovants et durables sur la QEI. La personne recrutée devra : • Développer une activité de recherche de haut niveau dans le domaine de la QEI, • Initier, conduire et coordonner des projets de recherche régionaux, nationaux et à terme européens, • Développer des actions de recherche contractuelle et de transfert de technologie en partenariat avec des acteurs du monde socio-économique, • Créer des passerelles entre les axes thématiques du CERI EE et les autres CERI en lien avec les domaines d'excellence d'IMT Nord Europe et de l'Institut Mines Télécom, • Encadrer des doctorants, des post-doctorants et des étudiants de Master, • Préparer une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches, • Participer au rayonnement de la thématique en lien étroit avec les autres collègues du CERI, notamment à l'international, • Publier dans les conférences et revues de référence du domaine, et participer à l'organisation d'événements scientifiques. Activités d'enseignement : Le CERI EE intervient dans l'ensemble des cursus Ingénieur. Il porte notamment deux des huit parcours de spécialité de l'école : GE (Génie Energétique) et GERI (Génie de l'Environnement et Risques Industriels) en formation initiale et une formation en apprentissage en Génie Energétique. Le CERI EE est également porteur de deux Mastères Spécialisés (MS) : le MS Bâtiment à Energie Positive, et le MS en Management des Risques Professionnels et Technologiques. Le CERI EE assure également des activités d'enseignements en formation continue, notamment en lien avec la QEI. Enfin, le CERI EE a pour projet de développer à court terme un projet de Master International « Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment » dans lequel la personne recrutée viendra en appui aux personnes en charge du développement de cette formation. La personne recrutée devra : • En lien avec le montage en cours d'un Master International Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment, proposer un projet d'enseignement qui viendra, en partie, en appui des pilotes de ce Master pour notamment : – Contribuer à la finalisation pédagogique et à la promotion de cette nouvelle formation, – Contribuer aux enseignements et tutorats des étudiants du master. En s'appuyant sur l'alliance européenne EuLiST, ce Master vise à aligner activités de recherche et d'enseignement. Ces enseignements devront être dispensés en anglais. • Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement dans les différentes formations proposées à l'Ecole, dans son domaine de spécialité (QEI) et dans des domaines connexes (ex : chimie, thermodynamique, ...) en fonction de son champ disciplinaire ; • Contribuer aux activités pédagogiques sur l'ensemble des formations portées par IMT Nord Europe, en fonction de ses domaines d'expertise et des besoins pédagogiques ; • Contribuer à la mise en place d'innovations pédagogiques intégrant les outils numériques (MOOC, classe inversée, etc.), • S'investir dans les activités d'encadrement pédagogique (projets, stages, tutorats) et de sélection (concours). PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme) La personne retenue devra être titulaire d'un doctorat et justifier d'une expérience de recherche dans le domaine de la Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ou dans une discipline contribuant à son étude, telle que la physico-chimie de l'air intérieur, l'évaluation de l'exposition individuelle, ou encore la performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments. description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. description: About Quandela Quandela is a global leader in photonic quantum computing, developing hardware and software technologies to build scalable and energy-efficient quantum systems. With more than 140 people, we develop our own stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic integrated circuits to quantum control systems, software and algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers. Reaching this scale requires increasingly reliable, manufacturable and integrated photonic hardware, making our Integrated Photonics team a key part of this journey. About this position: You will join our Integrated Photonics team, working across Massy and Palaiseau at the interface between PIC design, characterization, packaging and system integration. We are looking for a hands-on Photonic Packaging Engineer to take ownership of our packaging activities, improve existing processes and help make our PIC integration more reliable and reproducible. Your first priority will be to contribute to ongoing packaging activities, develop and improve assembly processes, and troubleshoot integration challenges alongside our PIC design and characterization teams. As you grow into the role, you will also have the opportunity to develop new packaging approaches, coordinate technical projects and contribute to building more structured and scalable packaging capabilities. Why this role matters: Today, packaging activities involve several members of our team. Having a dedicated engineer will help us accelerate ongoing developments, improve the reproducibility of our processes and strengthen the connection between PIC design, characterization and system integration. As our PIC platforms evolve, your work will also contribute to developing new integration approaches and preparing our packaging processes for future scale-up. Requirements What will you do: Develop and improve photonic packaging processes: • Take ownership of ongoing packaging activities and improve existing processes. • Develop optical coupling, precision alignment and fiber-array attachment methods. • Work on component assembly, bonding and electrical interconnections. • Address mechanical and thermal integration challenges. • Test new approaches, troubleshoot issues and improve process reproducibility. Qualify and improve packaged devices: • Build and test prototypes to validate packaging approaches. • Define performance metrics, tolerances and acceptance criteria. • Characterize packaged PICs alongside the PIC Characterization team. • Troubleshoot optical, electrical and mechanical integration issues. • Establish repeatable procedures and technical documentation. Connect packaging with PIC design: • Work closely with PIC Designers to anticipate packaging constraints. • Translate assembly challenges into practical design-for-packaging guidelines. • Collaborate with characterization and system-integration teams to improve packaged device performance. Build the packaging capability: • Collaborate with external packaging partners and equipment suppliers. • Improve existing equipment, assembly methods and internal capabilities. • Explore new packaging technologies and integration approaches. • Support automation to improve accuracy, reproducibility and throughput. • Progressively lead technical projects and contribute to future scale-up. How you'll grow: 0–3 months → Get familiar with our PIC platforms, existing packaging processes and integration challenges. Contribute to ongoing activities and start taking ownership of selected technical tasks. 3–6 months → Take increasing responsibility for packaging processes, develop and test improvements, and contribute to making our assembly methods more reliable and reproducible. 6–12 months → Lead packaging development activities within your area of expertise, strengthen our qualification and documentation practices, and contribute to new packaging approaches and technical projects. description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular ‘Hack Weeks’ to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we’re interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our “north star” is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you’ll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You’ll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we’d expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We’d ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We’ll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won’t discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email

Connect with us!

description:
Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.

This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

Job responsibilities

  • You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.
  • You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.
  • You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.
  • You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.
  • You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.
  • You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.
  • You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.
  • You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.
  • You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.
  • You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.
  • You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.
  • You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.
  • You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.
  • You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.

  • You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1892 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.

Responsibilities:

You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You will define the hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.

  • Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical/PQC hybrid schemes
  • Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.

You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)
  • Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards

Preferred Qualifications:

You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.

What We Offer:

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career
  • Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track
  • A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies
  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts
  • A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

Firmus AI Cloud

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

 

Role Summary

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. 

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity. 

This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth. 

 

Key Responsibilities

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure. 

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity. 

What you’ll bring 

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them. 

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance. 

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field. 

 

Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives. 

This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems — including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling — alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent optics, 100G/400G/800G) and IP backbone design (IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams. 

Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority

 

 

Location & Reporting

  • This role is based in Sydney, Australia.
  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

 

Employment Basis

Full-time

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design.
